description: Key design decisions, fixed bugs, academic rigor checklist, and gotchas for the Hybrid Pairs Trading project.
doNotLoad: Implementation/app.py (60KB ~15k tokens) — only for Streamlit UI changes
Implementation/core/selectors_ml.py (39KB ~10k tokens) — only for DL selector changes
Implementation/core/predictions.py (21KB ~5k tokens) — only for real-time prediction work
Implementation/experiments/walk_forward.py (28KB ~7k tokens) — only when modifying WFV script
Implementation/experiments/ablation.py (27KB ~6.5k tokens) — only when modifying ablation script
Implementation/experiments/results/ (raw JSON files) — never load in full; request metric extracts
Implementation/Research.md (54KB ~13k tokens) — use experiments.json graph node instead

fixedBugs.BUG-01: TransformerSelector Lambda layer incompatibility with TF GPU serialization. Fix: replaced Lambda with named _PositionalEncodingLayer subclass. All Transformer results pre-2026-04-06 are invalid.
fixedBugs.BUG-02: MLSelector._label() all-zero bug due to shift(-1) lookahead. Fix: removed shift(-1). MLSelector still hurts OOS.
fixedBugs.BUG-03: MLSignal LabelEncoder crash on unseen OOS labels. Fix: fixed LabelEncoder + installed xgboost.
fixedBugs.BUG-04: TATAMOTORS.NS had frequent missing bars. Fix: replaced with M&M.NS.
fixedBugs.BUG-05: yfinance frequency '1H' caused FutureWarning. Fix: changed to '1h' (lowercase).
fixedBugs.BUG-06: Wrong SLURM partition (cn3_l40s) and missing QOS. Fix: changed to cn3_anandi, added --qos=anandi.
fixedBugs.BUG-07: Floating Point Exception (SIGFPE) in RLSignal training. Fix: scaled reward to pp, clipped [-10,10], reduced n_steps 2048->512.
fixedBugs.BUG-08: Double-charging transaction costs on every trade. Fix: turnover = (sig_scaled - sig_prev).abs() * cost_frac / 2.0.
fixedBugs.BUG-09: entry_rl.py crashed on import when gymnasium not installed on Kalpana. Fix: lazy import + class guard behind 'gym is not None'.
fixedBugs.BUG-10: _metrics_oos returns {} for empty-pnl folds. Fix (first pass): added 'if m:' guard. Fix (second pass): 'has_metrics = bool(m)' captured BEFORE extra keys added to dict — otherwise empty dict mutated to truthy before check.

keyDecisions.D1: Daily (1D) data only. E1: daily Gross SR 1.14 vs hourly 0.49; hourly goes bankrupt after costs.
keyDecisions.D2: DEFAULT_MIN_HOLD = 30 trading days. E2 Pareto-optimal elbow (Net SR +0.481).
keyDecisions.D4: OU-only as Stage 2 signal. OUThreshold Net SR +0.359 vs ensemble -0.189 (old universe).
keyDecisions.D5: MLSelector weight = 0.0 in E7. Label mis-specification confirmed OOS.
keyDecisions.D6: INR 10 lakh capital, 1 lakh per pair.
keyDecisions.D8: IndianCosts dataclass with NSE-specific rates (STT, stamp duty, GST).
keyDecisions.D12: Transaction costs = 16.28 bps round-trip (corrected from 22.9 bps). Based on 2024-2026 NSE discount broker rates.
keyDecisions.D13: CPU-only ML mandatory on Kalpana. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='', TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS=1, seed=42. GPU code disabled for reproducibility.
keyDecisions.D14: Universe = 89 NSE Nifty100 tickers (not 35). Dropped: TATAMOTORS, BERGERPAINTS, VODAFONEIDEA, LTIM, ADANITRANS + 1 other.
keyDecisions.D15: Parquet cache for price data. Path: Implementation/experiments/data/nse_nifty100/prices_2015-01-01_2024-12-31.parquet
keyDecisions.D18: CNN selector disabled. Appendix B only.
keyDecisions.D19: Two-paper split: Paper 1 = ML ensemble vs stat baseline (current). Paper 2 = significance/contribution (submission-ready).
keyDecisions.D20: SLURM dependency chain for E1-E6 sequential submission.
keyDecisions.D21: Kalpana cannot push to GitHub. Pull locally via SSH remote (git fetch kalpana main && git merge kalpana/main).
keyDecisions.D22: Old results (backup_old_costs/) used 22.9 bps — must NOT be used for any paper claims.

academicRigorChecklist.look_ahead_bias: Addressed — selectors retrained per fold, no future data leaks
